conf.description: Infoblox NIOS DDI - dns-query (named combined query/response log), syslog-cef format. Branches the shared named syslog stream on the CEF:0|Infoblox|NIOS| prefix, parses CEF header+extensions and the nested msg RR-set grammar, de-collides the InfobloxDNSQFlags query/response overload, then maps to ECS.

conf.comment: infoblox-ddi / dns-query / syslog-cef. Per recommendations.direct.cribl this is parsed low-side/here, never sent through the stock infoblox_nios integration's pipeline_dns (its groks are BIND-grammar only and never match CEF). Two documented hazards handled explicitly: (1) Query Flags and Response Flags both use the extension key InfobloxDNSQFlags and collide - both occurrences are captured and kept separate; (2) the answer RR set lives inside the msg extension value and can itself contain '=' and spaces (TXT rdata) - parsed with a dedicated code step, not a naive kv split. The map's 'Timestamp' field names no literal CEF key, so _time is taken from the syslog header instead (the field's own notes flag this as an acceptable alternative) - see README gap.

functions.description: why this pipeline exists, scope, and the two known hazards
coarse guard: only CEF:0|Infoblox|NIOS| lines from the shared named stream continue
split the syslog header (timestamp, grid member, tag) from the CEF payload
split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension blob

explode the space-separated key=value CEF extensions (src, spt, dst, dest_port, InfobloxDNSView, destinationDnsDomain, InfobloxDNSQClass, InfobloxDNSQType, proto, InfobloxDNSRCode, transaction_id, opcode, and a first pass at msg/InfobloxDNSQFlags which the next two steps correct)
capture the full msg extension value (answer RR set) to end of line, undoing any truncation the kvp pass made on embedded '=' or spaces
de-collide InfobloxDNSQFlags: capture the query-side (first) and response-side (second) occurrences separately when both are present

conf.code: var rrs = String(__e['msg_raw']||'').split(';').map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(function(s){return s.length>0;}); var answers = []; var resolved = []; for (var i=0;i<rrs.length;i++){   var m = /^(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+([\s\S]*)$/.exec(rrs[i]);   if (m){     var rrType = m[4]; var rdata = m[5];     answers.push({name:m[1], ttl:parseInt(m[2],10), class:m[3], type:rrType, data:rdata});     if ((rrType==='A'||rrType==='AAAA') && resolved.indexOf(rdata)===-1){ resolved.push(rdata); }   } } __e['dns'] = __e['dns'] || {}; __e['dns']['answers'] = answers; if (resolved.length>0){ __e['dns']['resolved_ip'] = resolved; }

functions.description: parse msg_raw's semicolon-delimited RR set (name ttl class type rdata) into dns.answers[], feeding dns.resolved_ip from the A/AAAA members; rdata keeps embedded spaces/'=' intact since it is not further kv-split
